resources.string: Off keeps standard memory unchanged. Advanced records remain available for management in either mode. No GLOBAL.md, daily logs, or previous chats are imported automatically.

Embeddings v1 requires an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint with API-key credentials. OAuth, Azure, Anthropic, and Gemini endpoints are unsupported. Select an actual embedding model; a chat model may not support this endpoint. Changing models requires reindexing. Credentials are validated when an operation runs.
No eligible models. Add or enable a provider and model in Providers settings.
0–1. Higher values are stricter. Unrelated candidates are not forced into results. Test scores below before tuning.
Off by default. Requires advanced mode and a summarization model. Only eligible chats active after opt-in are scheduled; no historical backfill. Session memory controls still apply.

Enable automatic consolidation for eligible chats used after this opt-in? After the idle delay, visible user and assistant text is sent to your selected summarization provider and may incur charges. Tools, hidden reasoning, and files are excluded. Previous chats are not scanned or processed automatically. You can turn this off at any time.
Ready. No model request runs just by opening this page.
Operation completed. Review runtime status for details.
Operation cancelled. Completed items are retained.
Core memories and episode summaries can be managed even in standard mode. Manual additions and edits are protected from automatic replacement. Deleted source episodes are not recreated automatically.
Vector stored · semantic use requires a matching embedding model
Saving is local and marks this record as manually protected. Editing clears its old vector; reindex when needed. No model call is made.
Delete this record permanently? Its content and vector will be removed. A source-session marker is retained to prevent automatic recreation. This cannot be undone.

Shows all candidates returned by the bounded search, including rejected candidates, with reasons. Maximum accepted results applies to chat recall, not this debugger. Search safety limits may cap the candidates shown. This test works in standard mode and never inserts results into a chat.
Optional. The test button sends only this query to the selected embedding provider and may incur charges. Off uses local lexical search only.
Threshold used for this test: %1$.2f. Run again after changing settings or records.
No candidates. Nothing is forced into recall.
Embedding failed; showing local lexical results only: %1$s
Rebuild vectors for the selected embedding model without changing record text. You can cancel; vectors already completed remain saved.

Send stored advanced-memory text to the selected embedding provider to rebuild its vector index? This may incur cloud charges. Text remains local in the canonical store. You can cancel the operation; completed items are retained. Standard memory files and old chats are not imported.
Explicitly process one persisted session by ID. Requires advanced mode, a summarization model, and memory enabled for that session. No historical session list is scanned.

Send eligible visible user and assistant text from session %1$s to the selected summarization provider? This may incur charges and creates or updates its episode summary. Hidden reasoning, tool output, and files are excluded. Manual or deleted source episodes are not overwritten.
This record changed or was deleted. Close and reopen it before trying again.
